digest.component_or_area: live DC store-copy fixture and scrub
propositions: The store-copy scrub removes .bridge_state* artifacts at the start of dc_store_copy_repo but they are resurrected when run_ensures() calls the projects-seed ensure unit, which unconditionally recreates .bridge_state/projects.json after detecting its absence

The projects-seed ensure unit was added in commit 72731d3745 (epic 0303) after the scrub logic was established, creating an ordering regression where convergence silently reintroduces the cache the scrub removed
The live isolation test test_the_store_copy_is_complete_and_scrubbed fails because .bridge_state survives the scrub due to resurrection by run_ensures
A re-scrub of .bridge_state* with commit=True after run_ensures will remove the resurrected artifact from both worktree and tickets tree while preserving the .env-id store marker
